name: comp-165
blurb: Radio cards for selecting server locations, wrapping horizontally.
description: Server location selector as radio cards in a flex-wrap layout. Built on shadcn's RadioGroup.
use_when: Choosing deployment region or server location in a configuration form.
avoid_when: When many locations need to be listed — use a dropdown or searchable select.
a11y: Built on accessible RadioGroup with proper labels and focus management.
